name: Zoom
description: Read-only Zoom account access through a Server-to-Server OAuth app: users on the account, a user's scheduled meetings, one meeting's detail and a user's cloud recordings. No meeting is created, updated, ended or deleted by this connector.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users on the Zoom account (name, email, type, status, role and last login)

status.description: Optional user status to filter by (default active)

role_id.description: Optional role id to filter by

next_page_token.description: Optional paging token returned by a previous call

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: List a user's scheduled Zoom meetings (topic, type, start time, duration and join URL)

user_id.description: Zoom user id or email address; 'me' is the app's own account owner

next_page_token.description: Optional paging token returned by a previous call

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Get one Zoom meeting by id (topic, status, host, schedule, agenda and join URL)

meeting_id.description: Zoom meeting id (numeric) or meeting UUID

occurrence_id.description: Optional occurrence id for one instance of a recurring meeting

show_previous_occurrences.description: Optional: include previous occurrences of a recurring meeting

tools.name: list_recordings
tools.description: List a user's Zoom cloud recordings in a date range (meeting topic, start time, size and share URL)

user_id.description: Zoom user id or email address; 'me' is the app's own account owner

from.description: Optional start date, yyyy-mm-dd (Zoom defaults to the last month)

next_page_token.description: Optional paging token returned by a previous call

needs_review: AUTH IS SERVER-TO-SERVER OAUTH, NOT BASIC: the scaffold had auth {type: basic} with base_url https://zoom.us and a POST /oauth/token test, which only ever proved the token exchange and left no API surface. This spec uses auth.type oauth2_client_credentials with token_url https://zoom.us/oauth/token, grant_type account_credentials (Zoom's own name for the RFC 6749 4.4 exchange), extra_form {account_id} and client_auth basic, which is exactly what integrationTypeRegistry.js key zoom already sends in its testBody and testHeaders. base_url moved to the API host https://api.zoom.us, where every tool below lives.

SCOPES ARE AN ACCOUNT-SIDE PREREQUISITE: these four reads need user:read:admin (or user:read:list_users:admin), meeting:read:admin and cloud_recording:read:admin on the Server-to-Server OAuth app. A token minted without them authenticates and then 400s with code 4711 on the endpoint, so a missing scope looks like a working credential. Nothing in this spec can detect that; it is an account configuration step.

SHAPE-PROOF RESULT (real run, 2026-09-12, 1 iteration): verbatim overall line 'zoom  SHAPE_PROVEN  proven=5 authwall=0 ambiguous=0 failed=0 inconclusive=0 skipped=0'. All five probes (the test call plus four tools) answered 401 with the structured JSON body {"code":124,"message":"Invalid access token."}, while the bogus control path answered an HTML 404 marketing page: host, TLS, base_url https://api.zoom.us, the Authorization header handling and every path are proven by that differential.

TOKEN EXCHANGE IS NOT PROVEN BY THE SHAPE-PROOF: the harness fires a dummy bearer at api.zoom.us rather than running the account_credentials exchange, so the run above covers the API surface only. Whether client_auth basic plus grant_type account_credentials plus extra_form account_id actually mints a token at https://zoom.us/oauth/token is UNPROVEN here and needs one real Server-to-Server OAuth credential to confirm.

PAGE SIZE IS CLAMPED TO ZOOM'S DOCUMENTED CEILING: list_users, list_meetings and list_recordings all clamp page_size to default 30, max 300, the documented bounds. A caller asking for more gets 300 rather than a 400.

PROBE VALUES ARE SAFE AND READ-ONLY: _probe supplies user_id 'me' (Zoom's documented alias for the app's own account owner, so the path routes without naming a real person) and a well-formed but unallocated meeting id. No credential is ever hinted.

READ ONLY BY CONSTRUCTION: no tool is marked write:true and every request is a GET, so no meeting, registrant or recording can be mutated through this connector. Zoom's write surface (create, update, end, delete) is deliberately out of scope.
